title: docs(audits): the verdict/exit-code audit of check:merge-driver's three self-tests — all three immune
body:
Fixes #18166

Clause-②: no

This is an **audit** card, and the audit's answer is that **all three self-tests chained in
`check:merge-driver` are immune** to the verdict/exit-code split. Nothing was repaired, because
nothing is broken. No script in the population changed; the diff is one audit record under
`docs/audits/`. Written by session `session_019srGWGCBBCBHqcDoRZpQRh`.

## 1. The population, re-derived from the script

`package.json:19` on this branch, read rather than copied from the card, which said its own list
is a hint:

```
"check:merge-driver": "node scripts/git-env.mjs --self-test && node scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs --self-test"
```

Exactly three files, in this order — `scripts/git-env.mjs`, `scripts/git-merge-regen.mjs`,
`scripts/check-regen-pending.mjs`. The re-derivation agrees with the card's hint. They are chained
with `&&`, which is the whole reason the audit matters: a zero from any one of them **is** the gate
passing.

## 2. The gate's own exit code, before and after

| run | tree | exit |
|:--|:--|--:|
| `pnpm check:merge-driver` **before** | `0b31d90fb` (the branch point) | **0** |
| `pnpm check:merge-driver` **after** | `e18f4d2a7` (this head) | **0** |

Unchanged, and it has to be: no file the gate runs was edited.

## 3. The reading — exit code, never output

Per file: is there any path on which the dispatch prints a failing verdict, or counts a failure,
while the process still exits 0? Thirteen ablations, one mutation each, landed and verified **on
disk** by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit exactly once, occurrence counts and blob hash
before and after), then restored from `HEAD` with the restore proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty
`git diff HEAD`. No editor of the `-i` family was used and no mutation was left in the tree.

| # | file | the mutation | reading | direction |
|:--|:--|:--|--:|:--|
| A1 | `git-env.mjs` | one registered case reports failure | **1** | fires |
| A2 | `git-env.mjs` | failing verdict line kept, exit decoupled from the count | **0** | discriminates |
| A3 | `git-env.mjs` | case floor raised, so the floor summand fires | **1** | fires |
| A4 | `git-env.mjs` | `selfTest()` returns a value that is not the verdict | **1** | fires |
| B1 | `git-merge-regen.mjs` | `hookIsExecutable` reports failure by `return false` **alone** — no `fail()`, and it still prints its own tick | **1** | fires |
| B2 | `git-merge-regen.mjs` | a failure counted **and** PR #18165's `process.exitCode` line removed | **0** | discriminates |
| B3 | `git-merge-regen.mjs` | same forced count, that line left in place | **1** | fires |
| B4 | `git-merge-regen.mjs` | a `registerCase()` deleted, so the floor breaches through `fail()` | **1** | fires |
| C1 | `check-regen-pending.mjs` | `decisionTableSelfTest` returns false while all of its own rows print a tick | **1** | fires |
| C2 | `check-regen-pending.mjs` | a failure counted, verdict line still printed, exit decoupled | **0** | discriminates |
| C3 | `check-regen-pending.mjs` | same forced count, exit branch intact | **1** | fires |
| C4 | `check-regen-pending.mjs` | the inline `noDist` assertion forced false | **1** | fires |
| C5 | `check-regen-pending.mjs` | a `registerCase()` deleted, so the floor summand fires | **1** | fires |

**Ten firing controls, and they fire.** Every exit sink of every file is covered: git-env has two
sinks and three failure signals (A1/A3/A4), git-merge-regen has two (B1/B3 for the count,
B4 for `fail()`), check-regen-pending has one sink fed by three summands (C1/C4/C5). The record
lists each sink with its line number.

**Three discrimination controls, in the other direction.** Ten non-zero readings on their own are
also what an instrument that cannot see exit 0 produces. So each file additionally carries the same
forced failure with the count-to-exit coupling removed, and all three printed a failing verdict and
exited **0** — the card's defect, reproduced on each of the three files, by this exact reading:

```text
A2   git-env --self-test: 1 failure(s) [ABLATED: exit decoupled from the count]        exit 0
B2   merge driver wiring is inconsistent - 1 failure(s) (cases and floor); see above.  exit 0
C2   self-test failed -- 1 failure(s) [ABLATED: exit decoupled]                        exit 0
```

B3/C3 pair with B2/C2 on the same forced count and differ only in whether the coupling is present,
which isolates the coupling as the thing that makes the difference. B2 in particular measures that
PR #18165's repair line is load-bearing rather than decorative.

## 4. The judgement the card left open

The card raises one shared verdict/exit helper against three copies of `if (failures > 0)`,
expressly as a judgement on measurements. The measurement puts the repair population at **zero**,
so neither route earns itself: rewriting the verdict site of three working instruments would add
risk with no defect to remove, and `check:merge-driver` is itself the gate that would have to judge
that rewrite. **No gate weakened, no exemption added** — acceptance clause 2 holds trivially, since
no file the gate reads was touched.

## 5. Gates

Derived from the actual changed path, never from a named list:
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`, re-derived after
the `origin/main` merge so the stale-tree warning cleared.

**17 derived families, 17 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** — reconciled with `--ran`, which
confirms the zero is derived from recorded exit codes rather than claimed:

> dispatch-gates --ran: 17 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 17 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).

Every exit code was captured by redirecting first and reading `$?` second, never after a pipe.
One family needed a second pass: `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered **3**, its own
`PREREQUISITE NOT MET` code ("Nothing was measured"), because `@objectstack/formula` and
`@objectstack/lint` were unbuilt in a fresh worktree; after
`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` it answered **0**. That
3 is recorded as not-a-finding, not as a failed measurement.
`check:issue-citations --base origin/main` was also run defensively, since the diff adds four issue
citations: exit 0, and it read **0 files** — `docs/audits/` is outside its declared surface, so that
is a not-applicable rather than a pass.

**Repo-wide eslint, narrowed — and the narrowing is measured, not assumed.** Taken at
`e18f4d2a7`, this branch's final commit:

1. **Population, read from eslint's own config:** every config block in `eslint.config.mjs` scopes
   its `files` glob to `ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs`. No block names a Markdown extension.
2. **Count, from `--format json`:** 1 result for the changed path, carrying exactly one message —
   `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied.` Zero rules were evaluated on it.
3. **Invariance for untouched files:** `eslint.config.mjs` states, with its own positive control,
   that this repo "never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed
   `@typescript-eslint` rules) for ANY file". A one-file Markdown diff therefore cannot move the
   verdict of any file it does not contain.

So the narrowing excludes nothing: the only changed path is not in the examined population at all.
CI still runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

Observations from the audit, noted and deliberately **not** filed — none is a reproducible defect,
a declared-contract violation, or a metadata-authoring trap:

- `check-regen-pending.mjs`'s two inline dispatch assertions (`noDist`, `noTree`) sit outside the
  battery roster. That is a **declared** gap, stated at the roster with its cost and its reason,
  and this audit measures that both feed the same exit sink (C4). Not a finding. Successor: the
  reshape card the roster comment already points at.
- `fixtureSelfTest()` reduces with `results.every(Boolean)`, which is `true` over an empty array.
  It cannot be reached empty — every path that would skip the pushes throws out of a `try` with no
  `catch`, which exits non-zero — so it is not this card's class either. Noted for whoever next
  edits that function. Successor: none.
- `main()` in `check-regen-pending.mjs` is the production `pre-commit` / `pre-push` path and is
  outside `check:merge-driver`, which runs `--self-test` only. Its own verdict/exit coupling was
  read statically (its stale printers increment the same `blocked` count that `decide()` turns into
  the returned status) and deliberately **not** ablated. Successor: none.
- Linux only. macOS was not measured; #16717 records `check:merge-driver` staying red there for
  unrelated reasons, and #13799 is not addressed here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 一个文件:`docs/audits/2026-09-merge-driver-verdict-exit-split.md`。三个被审计的
脚本一个字节都没动。

**为什么改** —— 卡面要的是一次测量,不是一次修复:`check:merge-driver` 用 `&&` 串起三个
`--self-test`,任何一个「打印失败判决却退出 0」就让整条电池悄悄变成 advisory。测量结果是三个都
免疫,所以本 PR 的产物是那份可复核的审计记录本身,而不是代码改动。留在 GitHub 评论里的读数下一
个人复核不到,所以它落进仓库。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 风险接近零:无代码改动、无门禁改动、无豁免、不发布任何包
(`skip-changeset`)。回滚 = 删掉这一个文件。唯一的真实代价是 161 行仓内文档的维护面。
